builder.n_packed.unwrap_or(n_grid)\n322\t                } else {\n323\t                    n_grid\n324\t                };\n325\t                let packing = fields in multi-field messages\n346\t                    grid: prev_grid,\n347\t                    gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,\n348\t                    ..Default::default()\n349\t }\n355\t            _ => { /* Unknown section — skip */ }\n356\t        }\n357\t\n358\t        // Advance buf.pos to the end of this section.\n359\t        buf.pos = sec_start + sec_len;\n360\t        eprintln!(\"After section {}, buf.pos = {}\", sec_num, buf.pos);\n361\t    }\n362\t\n363\t    eprintln!(\"=== All sections parsed ===\");\n364\t    eprintln!(\"Final buf.pos: {}\", buf.pos);\n365\t    eprintln!(\"body_end (7777 location): {}\", body_end);\n366\t    eprintln!(\"Expected: buf.pos <= body_end\");\n367\t    eprintln!(\"Actual: buf.pos {} body_end\", if buf.pos <= body_end { \"<=\" } template number):\n725\t///\n726\t/// | Octets | Field |\n727\t/// |--------|-------|\n728\t/// | 15     | shape of earth |\n729\t/// | 16–20  | earth radius scale + value (skipped) |\n730\t/// | 21–25  | major-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n731\t/// | 26–30  | minor-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n732\t/// | 31–34  | Nx (Ni) |\n733\t/// | 35–38  | Ny (Nj) |\n734\t/// | 39–42  | basic angle (skipped) |\n735\t/// | 43–46  | basic angle subdivisions (skipped) |\n736\t/// | 47–50  | La1 (signed microdegrees) |\n737\t/// | 51–54  | Lo1 (unsigned microdegrees, 0–360) |\n738\t/// | 55     | resolution/component flags |\n739\t/// | 56–59  | La2 (signed microdegrees) |\n740\t/// | 60–63  | Lo2 (unsigned microdegrees, 0–360) |\n741\t/// | 64–67  | Di (unsigned microdegrees/1e6) |\n742\t/// | 68–71  | N (number of parallels between pole and equator) |\n743\t/// | 72     | scanning mode |\n744\t///\n745\t/// GDT 3.40 differs from GDT 3.0 only in octets 68–71: these hold N (a raw\n746\t/// unsigned 32-bit integer, not scaled) instead of Dj.  Dj is left as 0.0.\n747\tfn parse_gdt_40(b: &mut Buf, num_data_points: u32) -> Result<GridDefinition> {\n748\t    let shape_of_earth = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 15\n749\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 16–20: earth radius scale + value\n750\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 21–25: major axis\n751\t    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 26–30: minor axis\n752\t\n753\t    let nx = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 31–34\n754\t    let ny = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 35–38\n755\t\n756\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 39–42: basic angle\n757\t    b.skip(4)?;                           // oct 43–46: subdivisions\n758\t\n759\t    let lat_first = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 47–50\n760\t    let lon_first = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 51–54\n761\t    let resolution_flags = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 55\n762\t    let lat_last  = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 56–59\n763\t    let lon_last  = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 60–63\n764\t\n765\t    let di        = b.read_u32be()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;        // oct 64–67\n766\t    let n_parallels = b.read_u32be()?;                            // oct 68–71 (N, not Dj)\n767\t    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 72\n768\t\n769\t    let projection = GridProjection::GaussianLatLon(GaussianLatLonParams { n_parallels });\n770\t\n771\t    Ok(GridDefinition {\n772\t        template: 40,\n773\t        num_data_points,\n774\t        nx,\n775\t        ny,\n776\t        lat_first,\n777\t        lon_first,\n778\t        lat_last,\n779\t        lon_last,\n780\t        di,\n781\t        dj: 0.0,   // not stored in GDT 3.40; N replaces Dj\n782\t        scanning_mode,\n783\t        resolution_flags,\n784\t        shape_of_earth,\n785\t        projection,\n786\t    })\n787\t}\n788\t\n789\t// ── Section 4: Product Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────\n790\t\n791\tfn parse_section4(\n792\t    body: &[u8],\n793\t    discipline: u8,\n794\t) -> Result<(u16, ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n795\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n796\t    let _n_coord = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 6-7: number of coordinate values\n797\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 8-9: PDT template number\n798\t\n799\t    match template {\n800\t        0 => {\n801\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n802\t            Ok((0, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n803\t        }\n804\t        1 => {\n805\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_1(&mut b, discipline)?;\n806\t            Ok((1, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n807\t        }\n808\t        2 => {\n809\t            // Product Definition Template 4.2: Analysis or forecast at a horizontal level\n810\t            // Same as PDT 4.0 for our purposes (uses common header only)\n811\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n812\t            Ok((2, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n813\t        }\n814\t        8 => {\n815\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_8(&mut b, discipline)?;\n816\t            Ok((8, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n817\t        }\n818\t        11 => {\n819\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_11(&mut b, discipline)?;\n820\t            Ok((11, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n821\t        }\n822\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n823\t    }\n824\t}\n825\t\n826\t/// Parse the common PDT header fields shared by templates 4.0, 4.1, 4.8, 4.11.\n827\t///\n828\t/// Reads octets 10–34 (parameter, time, and level fields).  The caller reads\n829\t/// any template-specific tail octets after calling this function.\n830\tfn parse_pdt_common_header(\n831\t    b: &mut Buf,\n832\t    discipline: u8,\n833\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level)> {\n834\t    let category = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 10\n835\t    let number = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 11\n836\t    b.skip(1)?; // generating process type (oct 12)\n837\t    b.skip(1)?; // background generating process id (oct 13)\n838\t    b.skip(1)?; // analysis/forecast generating process id (oct 14)\n839\t    b.skip(2)?; // hours of cutoff after reference time (oct 15-16)\n840\t    b.skip(1)?; // minutes of cutoff (oct 17)\n841\t    let time_range_unit = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 18\n842\t    let forecast_offset = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 19-22\n843\t\n844\t    let type1 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 23\n845\t    let scale_factor1 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 24\n846\t    let scaled_value1 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 25-28\n847\t\n848\t    let raw_type2 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 29\n849\t    let raw_scale_factor2 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 30\n850\t    let raw_scaled_value2 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 31-34\n851\t\n852\t    // When second surface type is 255 (missing), zero out its scale/value\n853\t    // to match eccodes behavior.\n854\t    let (type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2) = if raw_type2 == 255 {\n855\t        (255u8, 0i8, 0i32)\n856\t    } else {\n857\t        (raw_type2, raw_scale_factor2, raw_scaled_value2)\n858\t    };\n859\t\n860\t    let param = ParameterId { discipline, category, number };\n861\t    // Reference time is filled in from Section 1 by the caller.\n862\t    let fore = ForecastTime {\n863\t        reference_time: ReferenceTime {\n864\t            year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, significance: 0,\n865\t        },\n866\t        time_range_unit,\n867\t        forecast_offset,\n868\t    };\n869\t    let lvl = Level { type1, scale_factor1, scaled_value1, type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2 };\n870\t\n871\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl))\n872\t}\n873\t\n874\t/// Product Definition Template 4.0: Analysis or forecast at horizontal level.\n875\tfn parse_pdt_0(\n876\t    b: &mut Buf,\n877\t    discipline: u8,\n878\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n879\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n880\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n881\t}\n882\t\n883\t/// Product Definition Template 4.1: Individual ensemble forecast, control and\n884\t/// perturbed, at a horizontal level at a point in time.\n885\t///\n886\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.1:\n887\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n888\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n889\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n890\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n891\tfn parse_pdt_1(\n892\t    b: &mut Buf,\n893\t    discipline: u8,\n894\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n895\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n896\t\n897\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35: Table 4.6\n898\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n899\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37: number in ensemble (unused by harness)\n900\t\n901\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n902\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n903\t}\n904\t\n905\t/// Product Definition Template 4.8: Average, accumulation, extreme values or\n906\t/// other statistically-processed values at a horizontal level in a continuous\n907\t/// or non-continuous time interval.\n908\t///\n909\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.8:\n910\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n911\t/// - Oct 35: year (u16), month, day, hour, minute, second of end of interval\n912\t/// - Oct 41: number of time range specifications (n)\n913\t/// - Octs 42 onward: n × 12-byte time range specifications (skipped)\n914\t///\n915\t/// Only the common header fields are surfaced; the statistical window\n916\t/// information is not yet modelled in `ForecastTime`.\n917\tfn parse_pdt_8(\n918\t    b: &mut Buf,\n919\t    discipline: u8,\n920\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n921\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n922\t\n923\t    // End-of-interval timestamp and time-range specs: skip entirely.\n924\t    // Oct 35-40: end time (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec = 7 bytes)\n925\t    b.skip(7)?;\n926\t    // Oct 41: number of time range specs\n927\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n928\t    // Each spec is 12 bytes.\n929\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n930\t\n931\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n932\t}\n933\t\n934\t/// Product Definition Template 4.11: Individual ensemble member +\n935\t/// time-processed statistical product at a horizontal level.\n936\t///\n937\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.11:\n938\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n939\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n940\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n941\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n942\t/// - Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n943\t/// - Oct 44: number of time range specifications (n)\n944\t/// - Octs 45+: n × 12-byte time range specs (skipped)\n945\tfn parse_pdt_11(\n946\t    b: &mut Buf,\n947\t    discipline: u8,\n948\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n949\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n950\t\n951\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35\n952\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n953\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37\n954\t\n955\t    // Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (7 bytes: year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n956\t    b.skip(7)?;\n957\t    // Oct 44: number of time range specs\n958\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n959\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n960\t\n961\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n962\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n963\t}\n964\t\n965\t// ── Section 5: Data Representation ───────────────────────────────────────────\n966\t\n967\tfn parse_section5(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, PackingInfo, Option<ComplexPackingExtra>, usize)> {\n968\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n969\t    let n_values = b.read_u32be()? as usize; // oct 6-9: number of packed values\n970\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?;           // oct 10-11: DRT template number\n971\t\n972\t    match template {\n973\t        0 => {\n974\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n975\t            Ok((0, packing, None, n_values))\n976\t        }\n977\t        2 => {\n978\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_2(&mut b)?;\n979\t            Ok((2, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n980\t        }\n981\t        3 => {\n982\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_3(&mut b)?;\n983\t            Ok((3, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n984\t        }\n985\t        4 => {\n986\t            // Template 5.4: IEEE 754 32-bit floats.\n987\t            let packing = parse_drt_4(&mut b)?;\n988\t            Ok((4, packing, None, n_values))\n989\t        }\n990\t        40 => {\n991\t            // Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n992\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n993\t            Ok((40, packing, None, n_values))\n994\t        }\n995\t        41 => {\n996\t            // Template 5.41: PNG data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n997\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n998\t            Ok((41, packing, None, n_values))\n999\t        }\n1000\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n1001\t    }\n1002\t}\n1003\t\n1004\t/// Parse the common packing header shared by DRT templates 0, 2, and 3.\n1005\tfn parse_drt_common(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<PackingInfo> {\n1006\t    let reference_value = b.read_f32be()?;               // oct 12-15: R\n1007\t    let binary_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 16-17: E\n1008\t    let decimal_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 18-19: D\n1009\t    let bits_per_value = b.read_u8()?;                   // oct 20: N\n1010\t    let original_field_type = b.read_u8()?;              // oct 21\n1011\t\n1012\t    Ok(PackingInfo {\n1013\t        reference_value,\n1014\t        binary_scale_factor,\n1015\t        decimal_scale_factor,\n1016\t        bits_per_value,\n1017\t        original_field_type,\n1018\t    })\n1019\t}\n1020\t\n1021\t/// Data Representation Template 5.2: Complex packing (no spatial differencing).\n1022\tfn parse_drt_2(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n1023\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n1024\t\n1025\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n1026\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n1027\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n1028\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n1029\t\n1030\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n1031\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n1032\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n1033\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n1034\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n1035\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n1036\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n1037\t    // Octets 48-49 (order_spatial_diff, extra_octet_count) are absent in template 5.2.\n1038\t\n1039\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n1040\t        n_groups,\n1041\t        ref_group_widths,\n1042\t        bits_group_widths,\n1043\t        ref_group_lengths,\n1044\t        length_increment,\n1045\t        true_last_group_length,\n1046\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n1047\t        order_spatial_diff: 0,\n1048\t        extra_octet_count: 0,\n1049\t    }))\n1050\t}\n1051\t\n1052\t/// Data Representation Template 5.3: Complex packing with spatial differencing.\n1053\tfn parse_drt_3(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n1054\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n1055\t\n1056\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n1057\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n1058\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n1059\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n1060\t\n1061\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n1062\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n1063\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n1064\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n1065\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n1066\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n1067\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n1068\t    let order_spatial_diff = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 48\n1069\t    let extra_octet_count = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 49\n1070\t\n1071\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n1072\t        n_groups,\n1073\t        ref_group_widths,\n1074\t        bits_group_widths,\n1075\t        ref_group_lengths,\n1076\t        length_increment,\n1077\t        true_last_group_length,\n1078\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n1079\t        order_spatial_diff,\n1080\t        extra_octet_count,\n1081\t    }))\n1082\t}\n1083\t\n1084\t/// Data Representation Template 5.4: IEEE 754 32-bit floats.\n1085\t///\n1086\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 5.4:\n1087\t/// - Octs 12-21: common packing header (same as DRT=0)\n1088\t/// - Oct 22-23: reserved (must be 0)\n1089\tfn parse_drt_4(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<PackingInfo> {\n1090\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n1091\t\n1092\t    // Oct 22-23: reserved (must be 0 per WMO spec)\n1093\t    let reserved1 = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 22\n1094\t    let reserved2 = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 23\n1095\t    if reserved1 != 0 || reserved2 != 0 {\n1096\t        return Err(Error::InvalidData(\"DRT=4 reserved octets must be 0\"));\n1097\t    }\n1098\t\n1099\t    Ok(packing)\n1100\t}\n1101\t\n1102\t// ── Section 6: Bit Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1103\t\n1104\t/// Parse Section 6 (Bit Map).\n1105\t///\n1106\t/// Returns `(has_bitmap, bitmap_bytes)`:\n1107\t/// - `has_bitmap=false, bitmap_bytes=None` when indicator == 255 (all points present).\n1108\t/// - `has_bitmap=true, bitmap_bytes=Some(bytes)` when indicator == 0: one bit per grid\n1109\t///   point, MSB-first packed, length = ceil(n_grid_points / 8).\n1110\tfn parse_section6(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(bool, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {\n1111\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n1112\t    let indicator = b.read_u8()?; // oct 6\n1113\t    match indicator {\n1114\t        255 => Ok((false, None)),\n1115\t        0 => {\n1116\t            // Remaining bytes are the bitmap (1 bit per grid point, MSB first).\n1117\t            let bitmap = body[1..].to_vec();\n1118\t            Ok((true, Some(bitmap)))\n1119\t        }\n1120\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n1121\t    }\n1122\t}\n1123\t\n1124\t// ── Bitmap expansion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1125\t\n1126\t/// Expand a vector of packed (present-only) values into a full `n_grid`-length\n1127\t/// masked grid using the bitmap.\n1128\t///\n1129\t/// The bitmap is a packed MSB-first bit array (one bit per grid point). Where\n1130\t/// the bit is 1, the next value from `packed` is used; where 0, the grid point\n1131\t/// is absent (value = 0.0, present = false). Returns `GridValues::Masked` if\n1132\t/// a bitmap is provided and `n_packed < n_grid`, otherwise returns the input\n1133\t/// as a `Dense` grid.\n1134\tfn expand_bitmap(\n1135\t    packed: GridValues,\n1136\t    bitmap: &Option<Vec<u8>>,\n1137\t    n_grid: usize,\n1138\t) -> GridValues {\n1139\t    let bm = match bitmap {\n1140\t        Some(bm) => bm,\n1141\t        None => return packed, // no bitmap — pass through\n1142\t    };\n1143\t\n1144\t    let packed_vals = match packed {\n1145\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => v,\n1146\t        other => return other, // already masked somehow — pass through\n1147\t    };\n1148\t\n1149\t    if packed_vals.len() == n_grid {\n1150\t        // The packed count already matches the grid — no expansion needed.\n1151\t        return GridValues::Dense(packed_vals);\n1152\t    }\n1153\t\n1154\t    let mut values = vec![0.0f64; n_grid];\n1155\t    let mut present = vec![false; n_grid];\n1156\t    let mut packed_idx = 0usize;\n1157\t\n1158\t    for grid_idx in 0..n_grid {\n1159\t        let byte = grid_idx / 8;\n1160\t        let bit = 7 - (grid_idx % 8); n_points]))\n1214\t        }\n1215\t        n_bits => {\n1216\t            let packed = unpack_n_bits(body, n_points, n_bits as usize);\n1217\t            // WMO spec: Y × 10^D = R + X × 2^E  →  Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D\n1218\t            let values: Vec<f64> = packed.iter().map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d).collect();\n1219\t            Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1220\t        }\n1221\t    }\n1222\t}\n1223\t\n1224\t/// Decode Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression.\n1225\t///\n1226\t/// Section 7 contains a JPEG 2000 codestream (J2K) or JP2 container. The first\n1227\t/// component carries packed integers X; decoded values follow: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1228\t#[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1229\tfn decode_drt40(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1230\t    let img = jpeg2k::Image::from_bytes(body)\n1231\t        .map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"JPEG2000 decode failed\"))?;\n1232\t    let comp = img.components().first()\n1233\t        .ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: no image components\"))?;\n1234\t\n1235\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1236\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1237\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1238\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1239\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1240\t\n1241\t    let data = comp.data(); // &[i32] — raw packed integer X values\n1242\t    let values: Vec<f64> = data.iter()\n1243\t        .take(n_points)\n1244\t        .map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1245\t        .collect();\n1246\t\n1247\t    if values.len() < n_points {\n1248\t        return Err(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: fewer pixels than grid points\"));\n1249\t    }\n1250\t\n1251\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1252\t}\n1253\t\n1254\t/// Decode Template 5.41: PNG data compression.\n1255\t///\n1256\t/// Section 7 contains a raw PNG image. Pixel values are packed integers X;\n1257\t/// decoded grid values follow the standard formula: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1258\t/// Only 8-bit and 16-bit grayscale PNGs are supported (the common GRIB2 case).\n1259\tfn decode_drt41(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1260\t    let cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(body);\n1261\t    let decoder = png::Decoder::new(cursor);\n1262\t    let mut reader = decoder.read_info().map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"PNG header decode failed\"))?;\n1263\t\n1264\t    let buf_size = reader.output_buffer_size().ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"PNG: buffer size unknown\"))?;\n1265\t    let mut img_data = vec![0u8; buf_size];\n1266\t    let info = reader.next_frame(&mut img_data).map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"PNG frame decode failed\"))?;\n1267\t\n1268\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1269\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1270\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1271\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1272\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1273\t\n1274\t    let values: Vec<f64> = match (info.bit_depth, info.color_type) {\n1275\t        (png::BitDepth::Eight, png::ColorType::Grayscale) => {\n1276\t            img_data[..n_points]\n1277\t                .iter()\n1278\t                .map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1279\t                .collect()\n1280\t        }\n1281\t        (png::BitDepth::Sixteen, png::ColorType::Grayscale) => {\n1282\t            img_data[..n_points * 2]\n1283\t                .chunks_exact(2)\n1284\t                .map(|b| u16::from_be_bytes([b[0], b[1]]) as f64)\n1285\t                .map(|x| (r + x * two_e) / ten_d)\n1286\t                .collect()\n1287\t        }\n1288\t        _ => return Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n1289\t    };\n1290\t\n1291\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1292\t}\n1293\t\n1294\t/// Decode Template 5.4: IEEE 754 32-bit floats.\n1295\t///\n1296\t/// Section 7 contains raw 4-byte big-endian IEEE 754 float values. No\n1297\t/// scaling or unpacking is applied — the floats are returned as-is.\n1298\tfn decode_drt4(body: &[u8], n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1299\t    let bytes_needed = n_points * 4;\n1300\t    if body.len() < bytes_needed {\n1301\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: bytes_needed, got: body.len() });\n1302\t    }\n1303\t\n1304\t    let values: Vec<f64> = body[..bytes_needed]\n1305\t        .chunks_exact(4)\n1306\t        .map(|c| f32::from_be_bytes([c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]]) as f64)\n1307\t        .collect();\n1308\t\n1309\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1310\t}\n1311\t\n1312\t/// Decode Template 5.3: complex packing with spatial differencing.\n1313\t///\n1314\t/// The Section 7 body contains:\n1315\t///   1. `(order+1) × extra_octet_count` bytes: seed values (ival1, [ival2,] minsd) in\n1316\t///      GRIB2 sign-magnitude big-endian encoding.\n1317\t///   2. `n_groups × bits_per_value` bits (byte-aligned sub-array): group references.\n1318\t///   3. `n_groups × bits_group_widths` bits (byte-aligned): group width offsets.\n1319\t///   4. `n_groups × bits_scaled_group_lengths` bits (byte-aligned): scaled group lengths\n1320\t///      (last group uses `true_last_group_length` from Section 5 instead).\n1321\t///   5. Data values packed within groups (per-group bit width).\n1322\t///\n1323\t/// All sub-arrays are byte-aligned (padded to the next byte boundary between arrays).\n1324\tfn decode_drt3(\n1325\t    body: &[u8],\n1326\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1327\t    extra: &ComplexPackingExtra,\n1328\t    n_points: usize,\n1329\t) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1330\t    let order = extra.order_spatial_diff as usize;\n1331\t    let eo = extra.extra_octet_count as usize;\n1332\t    let n_groups = extra.n_groups as usize;\n1333\t    let total_seed_bytes = (order + 1) * eo;\n1334\t\n1335\t    if body.len() < total_seed_bytes {\n1336\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: total_seed_bytes, got: body.len() });\n1337\t    }\n1338\t\n1339\t    // 1. Packed values within groups (variable bit width per group).\n1392\t    // Calculate the total bits needed for all groups to ensure we have sufficient buffer.\n1393\t    let total_bits_needed: usize = group_widths.iter().zip(group_lengths.iter())\n1394\t        .map(|(&w, &l)| w * l)\n1395\t        .sum();\n1396\t    // Account for the starting bit offset when calculating byte requirements.\n1397\t    // If we start at bit_offset within byte byte_pos, and need total_bits_needed more bits,\n1398\t    // the last bit we'll read is at bit_offset + total_bits_needed - 1.\n1399\t    // The byte containing that last bit is at position (last_bit / 8).\n1400\t    // Since bytes are 0-indexed, we need bytes 0..(last_bit / 8 + 1), which is (last_bit / 8 + 1) bytes total.\n1401\t    // When total_bits_needed is 0 (all zero-width groups), we need 0 bytes.\n1402\t    let bytes_needed_packed = if total_bits_needed == 0 {\n1403\t        0\n1404\t    } else {\n1405\t        let start_bit = byte_pos * 8;\n1406\t        let last_bit = start_bit + total_bits_needed - 1;\n1407\t        let last_byte = last_bit / 8;\n1408\t        last_byte - byte_pos + 1\n1409\t    };\n1410\t    check_bytes(bytes_needed_packed, body.len(), byte_pos, \"packed values\")?;\n1411\t\n1412\t    let mut packed = Vec::with_capacity(n_points);\n1413\t    let mut bit_offset = byte_pos * 8;\n1414\t    for g in 0..n_groups {\n1415\t        let w = group_widths[g];\n1416\t        let l = group_lengths[g];\n1417\t        let gref = group_refs[g] as i64;\n1418\t        if w == 0 {\n1419\t            // Zero-width group: all values equal the group reference.\n1420\t            // Extending without any bit reads — common in flat regions.\n1421\t            for _ in 0..l { packed.push(gref); }\n1422\t            continue;\n1423\t        }\n1424\t\n1425\t\n1426\t        // Generic windowed extractor — the sole extractor path. Per-width\n1427\t        // specializations (scalar w=4/8/12/16 in Attempts 6/8, SIMD AVX2 in Attempt 9)\n1428\t        // were benchmarked A/B vs this path and showed no measurable win (within\n1429\t        // run-to-run noise). The generic extractor already incorporates the\n1430\t        // Attempt 4+5 optimizations (+38–40% vs pre-windowed baseline) and\n1431\t        // remains fast and correct.\n1432\t        let start_bit = bit_offset;\n1433\t        extract_group_windowed(body, start_bit, w, l, gref, &mut packed);\n1434\t        bit_offset = start_bit + w * l;\n1435\t    }\n1436\t\n1437\t    if packed.len() != n_points {\n1438\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: n_points, got: packed.len() });\n1439\t    }\n1440\t\n1441\t    // 6+7. Reconstruct integers via spatial differencing and apply the packing\n1442\t    //    formula in a single combined pass (Attempt 5 in parse-speed-log.md).\n1443\t    //\n1444\t    //    Previously: two separate O(n) passes — in-place spatial diff over `packed`\n1445\t    //    (writing i64), then a scaling pass into `values` (reading i64, writing f64).\n1446\t    //    For a 65 K-point field each pass reads/writes ~520 KB; with two passes the\n1447\t    //    vector is read twice from L3/RAM after it exceeds L2.\n1448\t    //\n1449\t    //    Now: one combined pass reads each `packed[i]` exactly once, applies the\n1450\t    //    running-sum state inline, and immediately writes the scaled f64 to `values`.\n1451\t    //    The `packed` Vec is never mutated after construction; `values` is filled in\n1452\t    //    a single sequential write — friendlier for the prefetcher.\n1453\t    //\n1454\t    //    Seed values (ival1, ival2) are emitted directly from the seed variables\n1455\t    //    rather than by overwriting packed[0..order], so no in-place writes happen.\n1456\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1457\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(packing.binary_scale_factor as i32);\n1458\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32);\n1459\t    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(n_points);\n1460\t\n1461\t    if order == 0 {\n1462\t        // DRT=2: no spatial differencing — scale directly.\n1463\t        for &x in &packed {\n1464\t            values.push((r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1465\t        }\n1466\t    } else if order == 1 {\n1467\t        // Position 0 is the seed ival1; packed[1..] hold first-order differences\n1468\t        // (with minsd subtracted by the encoder to keep them non-negative).\n1469\t        if !packed.is_empty() {\n1470\t            values.push((r + ival1 as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1471\t        }\n1472\t        let mut prev = ival1;\n1473\t        for i in 1..packed.len() {\n1474\t            prev += packed[i] + minsd;\n1475\t            values.push((r + prev as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1476\t        }\n1477\t    } else if order == 2 {\n1478\t        // Positions 0 and 1 are seeds ival1/ival2; packed[2..] hold second-order\n1479\t        // differences. The first-order difference at position 1 is ival2 − ival1.\n1480\t        if !packed.is_empty() {\n1481\t            values.push((r + ival1 as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1482\t        }\n1483\t        if packed.len() >= 2 {\n1484\t            values.push((r + ival2 as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1485\t        }\n1486\t        let mut delta = ival2 - ival1; // first-order diff at position 1\n1487\t        let mut prev = ival2;\n1488\t        for i in 2..packed.len() {\n1489\t            let second_diff = packed[i] + minsd;\n1490\t            delta += second_diff;\n1491\t            prev += delta;\n1492\t            values.push((r + prev as f64 * two_e) / ten_d);\n1493\t        }\n1494\t    }\n1495\t\n1496\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1497\t}\n1498\t\n1499\t/// Read a GRIB2 sign-magnitude big-endian integer from `bytes`.\n1500\t///\n1501\t/// The MSB of the first byte is the sign (1 = negative); the remaining bits\n1502\t/// form the unsigned magnitude.\n1503\tfn read_sign_magnitude_be(bytes: &[u8]) -> i64 {\n1504\t    let n = bytes.len();\n1505\t    debug_assert!(n > 0 && n <= 7, \"sign-magnitude: unsupported width {n}\");\n1506\t    let mut raw = 0u64;\n1507\t    for &b in bytes {\n1508\t        raw = (raw << 8) | b as u64;\n1509\t    }\n1510\t    let sign_bit = 1u64 << (n * 8 - 1);\n1511\t    let magnitude = (raw & (sign_bit - 1)) as i64;\n1512\t    if raw & sign_bit != 0 { -magnitude } else { magnitude }\n1513\t}\n1514\t\n1515\t/// Extract `count` values each `w` bits wide from `data` starting at `start_bit`,\n1516\t/// pushing `gref + raw_value` onto `out` for each.\n1517\t///\n1518\t/// Uses a left-aligned u64 sliding window (MSB-first, matching GRIB2 bit order)\n1519\t/// instead of per-element [`read_bits_at`] calls.  The key savings vs. the\n1520\t/// per-element path:\n1521\t///\n1522\t/// * No `div_ceil` per element — `bytes_needed` is computed once on pre-fill.\n1523\t/// * No inner byte-assembly loop per element — bytes are amortised over a\n1524\t///   window: one byte loaded per 8 bits consumed on average.\n1525\t/// * Single `shift + mask` per value instead of 3–9 byte-load + shift operations.\n1526\t///\n1527\t/// The left-aligned invariant: valid bits always occupy the MSB positions of\n1528\t/// `buf`, so the next `w`-bit value is always extracted as `(buf >> (64 - w)) & mask`.\n1529\t///\n1530\t/// # Panics (debug only)\n1531\t/// `w` must satisfy `0 < w ≤ 32`.  The caller is responsible for the w=0 fast\n1532\t/// path (zero-width groups).\n1533\t#[inline]\n1534\tfn extract_group_windowed(\n1535\t    data: &[u8],\n1536\t    start_bit: usize,\n1537\t    w: usize,\n1538\t    count: usize,\n1539\t    gref: i64,\n1540\t    out: &mut Vec<i64>,\n1541\t) {\n1542\t    debug_assert!(w > 0 && w <= 32, \"w={w} out of range (caller must handle w=0)\");\n1543\t    let mask: u64 = (1u64 << w) - 1;\n1544\t\n1545\t    // `buf` holds up to 64 bits of stream data, left-aligned (MSB = next bit).\n1546\t    // `buf_bits` tracks how many valid bits sit at the top of `buf`.\n1547\t    let mut buf: u64 = 0;\n1548\t    let mut buf_bits: usize = 0;\n1549\t    let mut byte_pos = start_bit / 8;\n1550\t    let skip = start_bit % 8; // alignment bits to discard before the first value\n1551\t\n1552\t    // Inline loader: place data[byte_pos] at the next available MSB position.\n1553\t    // Precondition: buf_bits ≤ 56 (so buf_bits + 8 ≤ 64, no overflow).\n1554\t    // buf_bits stays ≤ 40 in the inner loop (analysis below), so this always holds.\n1555\t    macro_rules! load_byte {\n1556\t        () => {\n1557\t            if byte_pos < data.len() {\n1558\t                buf |= (data[byte_pos] as u64) << (56 - buf_bits);\n1559\t                buf_bits += 8;\n1560\t            }\n1561\t            // Always advance byte_pos (prevents infinite loop on malformed data).\n1562\t            byte_pos += 1;\n1563\t        };\n1564\t    }\n1565\t\n1566\t    // Pre-fill: load enough bytes so buf holds at least (skip + w) valid bits.\n1567\t    // Worst case: skip=7, w=32 → 39 bits → 5 bytes → buf_bits ≤ 40 after pre-fill.\n1568\t    let init_bytes = (skip + w + 7) / 8;\n1569\t    for _ in 0..init_bytes {\n1570\t        load_byte!();\n1571\t    }\n1572\t\n1573\t    // Discard the alignment prefix (bits before start_bit within the first byte).\n1574\t    if skip > 0 {\n1575\t        buf <<= skip;\n1576\t        buf_bits -= skip;\n1577\t    }\n1578\t\n1579\t    // Main extraction loop.\n1580\t    // After `buf <<= w`, buf_bits decreases by w.  After at most ceil(w/8)\n1581\t    // refills (each adding 8 bits), buf_bits ≤ w + 8*ceil(w/8) ≤ 40 for w ≤ 32.\n1582\t    for _ in 0..count {\n1583\t        // Refill if needed (at most ceil(w/8) ≤ 4 iterations for w ≤ 32).\n1584\t        while buf_bits < w {\n1585\t            load_byte!();\n1586\t        }\n1587\t\n1588\t        // Extract the top w bits and advance the window.\n1589\t        let v = (buf >> (64 - w)) & mask;\n1590\t        buf <<= w;\n1591\t        buf_bits -= w;\n1592\t\n1593\t        out.push(gref + v as i64);\n1594\t    }\n1595\t}\n1596\t\n1597\t/// Read `n_bits` bits from `data` starting at `bit_offset` (MSB-first).\n1598\tfn read_bits_at(data: &[u8], bit_offset: usize, n_bits: usize) -> u64 {\n1599\t    if n_bits == 0 {\n1600\t        return 0;\n1601\t    }\n1602\t    let byte_start = bit_offset / 8;\n1603\t    let bit_start = bit_offset % 8;\n1604\t    let bits_needed = bit_start + n_bits;\n1605\t    let bytes_needed = bits_needed.div_ceil(8);\n1606\t    let mut raw: u64 = 0;\n1607\t    for i in 0..bytes_needed {\n1608\t        let byte = if byte_start + i < data.len() { data[byte_start + i] } else { 0 };\n1609\t        raw = (raw << 8) | byte as u64;\n1610\t    }\n1611\t    let total_bits = bytes_needed * 8;\n1612\t    let shift = total_bits - bit_start - n_bits;\n1613\t    let mask = (1u64 << n_bits) - 1;\n1614\t    (raw >> shift) & mask\n1615\t}\n1616\t\n1617\t/// Extract `count` unsigned integers each `n_bits` wide from `data`.\n1618\t/// Bits are packed MSB-first: the first value occupies bits [0..n_bits-1]\n1619\t/// of the bitstream (bit 0 = MSB of data[0]).\n1620\tfn unpack_n_bits(data: &[u8], count: usize, n_bits: usize) -> Vec<u64> {\n1621\t    if n_bits == 0 {\n1622\t        return vec![0u64; count];\n1623\t    }\n1624\t    // Fast paths for byte-aligned widths — avoids per-element shift/mask\n1625\t    // overhead and exposes the inner loops to compiler auto-vectorization.\n1626\t    match n_bits {\n1627\t        8 => {\n1628\t            let available = count.min(data.len());\n1629\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data[..available].iter().map(|&b| b as u64).collect();\n1630\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1631\t            return v;\n1632\t        }\n1633\t        16 => {\n1634\t            let available = count.min(data.len() / 2);\n1635\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data.chunks_exact(2)\n1636\t                .take(available)\n1637\t                .map(|c| u16::from_be_bytes([c[0], c[1]]) as u64)\n1638\t                .collect();\n1639\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1640\t            return v;\n1641\t        }\n1642\t        32 => {\n1643\t            let available = count.min(data.len() / 4);\n1644\t            let mut v: Vec<u64> = data.chunks_exact(4)\n1645\t                .take(available)\n1646\t                .map(|c| u32::from_be_bytes([c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]]) as u64)\n1647\t                .collect();\n1648\t            v.resize(count, 0);\n1649\t            return v;\n1650\t        }\n1651\t        _ => {}\n1652\t    }\n1653\t\n1654\t    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(count);\n1655\t    let mut bit_offset = 0usize;\n1656\t\n1657\t    for _ in 0..count {\n1658\t        let byte_start = bit_offset / 8;\n1659\t        let bit_start = bit_offset % 8;\n1660\t        let bits_needed = bit_start + n_bits;\n1661\t        let bytes_needed = bits_needed.div_ceil(8);\n1662\t\n1663\t        let mut raw: u64 = 0;\n1664\t        for i in 0..bytes_needed {\n1665\t            let byte = if byte_start + i < data.len() { data[byte_start + i] } else { 0 };\n1666\t            raw = (raw << 8) | byte as u64;\n1667\t        }\n1668\t\n1669\t        // raw has bytes_needed * 8 bits, value lives at the top n_bits\n1670\t        // after shifting past the leading bit_start bits.\n1671\t        let total_bits = bytes_needed * 8;\n1672\t        let shift = total_bits - bit_start - n_bits;\n1673\t        let mask = (1u64 << n_bits) - 1;\n1674\t        values.push((raw >> shift) & mask);\n1675\t\n1676\t        bit_offset += n_bits;\n1677\t    }\n1678\t\n1679\t    values\n1680\t}\n1681\t\n1682\t// ── Lazy / partial decode (DRT=0 only) ───────────────────────────────────────\n1683\t\n1684\t/// Decode a single grid point from a DRT=0 (simple packing) Section 7 body.\n1685\t///\n1686\t/// Returns `None` when `idx` is out of range for the given body length and\n1687\t/// packing, or when `bits_per_value` is non-zero but the bit span for `idx`\n1688\t/// exceeds the body.  Returns a value for all indices when `bits_per_value == 0`\n1689\t/// (constant field).\n1690\tpub fn decode_point_drt0(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, idx: usize) -> Option<f64> {\n1691\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1692\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(packing.binary_scale_factor as i32);\n1693\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32);\n1694\t\n1695\t    if packing.bits_per_value == 0 {\n1696\t        return Some(r / ten_d);\n1697\t    }\n1698\t\n1699\t    let n = packing.bits_per_value as usize;\n1700\t    let bit_offset = idx * n;\n1701\t    let byte_end = (bit_offset + n).div_ceil(8);\n1702\t    if byte_end > body.len() {\n1703\t        return None;\n1704\t    }\n1705\t    let x = read_bits_at(body, bit_offset, n);\n1706\t    Some((r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1707\t}\n1708\t\n1709\t/// Decode all grid values from a DRT=2 or DRT=3 (complex packing) Section 7 body.\n1710\t///\n1711\t/// This is the public entry point for the \"decode-once-extract-many\" pattern:\n1712\t/// decode the full grid once and cache the `Vec<f64>`, then do O(1) index\n1713\t/// lookups for each station.  For DRT=3 (spatial differencing), random access\n1714\t/// is impossible without a full decode because each value depends on all prior\n1715\t/// values in the differencing reversal step.\n1716\t///\n1717\t/// `body` is the raw Section 7 body (from `LazyField::section7_raw`).\n1718\t/// `packing` is from `LazyField::packing`.\n1719\t/// `extra` is from `LazyField::complex_extra` (must be `Some` for DRT=2/3).\n1720\t/// `n_points` is `LazyField::grid.num_data_points as usize`.\n1721\tpub fn decode_all_drt3(\n1722\t    body: &[u8],\n1723\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1724\t    extra: &ComplexExtra,\n1725\t    n_points: usize,\n1726\t) -> Result<Vec<f64>> {\n1727\t    match decode_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points)? {\n1728\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => Ok(v),\n1729\t        GridValues::Masked { values, .. } => Ok(values),\n1730\t    }\n1731\t}\n1732\t\n1733\t/// Extract a single grid point from a DRT=2 or DRT=3 (complex packing) Section 7 body.\n1734\t///\n1735\t/// Decodes the full grid and returns `values[idx]`.\n1736\t///\n1737\t/// **Performance note:** For DRT=3 (spatial differencing), each call decodes\n1738\t/// the entire grid — random access is impossible because each value depends on\n1739\t/// all prior values.  When extracting multiple stations from the same field,\n1740\t/// prefer [`decode_all_drt3`] (decode once, cache, index in O(1)) to avoid\n1741\t/// paying the full-decode cost N `LazyField::packing`.\n1747\t/// `extra` is `LazyField::complex_extra.as_ref().unwrap()` (must be `Some` for DRT=2/3).\n1748\t/// `n_points` is `LazyField::grid.num_data_points as usize`.\n1749\tpub fn decode_point_drt3(\n1750\t    body: &[u8],\n1751\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1752\t    extra: &ComplexExtra,\n1753\t    n_points: usize,\n1754\t    idx: usize,\n1755\t) -> Option<f64> {\n1756\t    if idx >= n_points {\n1757\t        return None;\n1758\t    }\n1759\t    let values = decode_all_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points).ok()?;\n1760\t    values.get(idx).copied()\n1761\t}\n1762\t\n1763\t/// Decode all fields lazily — Section 7 data is stored as raw bytes.\n1764\t///\n1765\t/// DRT=0 fields without a bitmap: `section7_raw` is populated;    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 26–30: minor axis\n\n    let nx = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 31–34: Nx\n    let ny = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 35–38: Ny\n\n    let lat_first = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 39–42: La1\n    let lon_first = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 43–46: Lo1\n    let resolution_flags = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 47\n\n    let lat_last = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 48–51: La2\n    let lon_last = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 52–55: Lo2\n    let di = b.read_u32be()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;               // oct 56–59: Di\n    let dj = b.read_u32be()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;               // oct 60–63: Dj\n\n    // Rotated pole parameters\n    let lat_pole_rot = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0; // oct 64–67: south pole latitude\n    let lon_pole_rot = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;  // oct 68–71: south pole longitude\n    let angle_rot_raw = b.read_u8()? as f64;                         // oct 72: angle of rotation\n    let angle_rot = angle_rot_raw / 100.0;  // Last 2 digits are fractional\n    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;                               // oct 73: scanning mode\n\n    let projection = GridProjection::RotatedLatLon(RotatedLatLonParams {\n        lat_pole_rot,\n        lon_pole_rot,\n        angle_rot,\n    });\n\n    Ok(GridDefinition {\n        template: 1,\n        num_data_points,\n        nx,\n        ny,\n        lat_first,\n        lon_first,\n        lat_last,\n        lon_last,\n        di,\n        dj,\n        scanning_mode,\n        resolution_flags,\n        shape_of_earth,\n        projection,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Grid Definition Template 3.20: Polar Stereographic Projection.\n///\n/// Byte layout (b starts at section octet 15 = first body byte after template number):\n///\n/// | Octets | Field |\n/// |--------|-------|\n/// | 15     | shape of earth |\n/// | 16–20  | earth radius scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 21–25  | major-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 26–30  | minor-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 31–34  | Nx |\n/// | 35–38  | Ny |\n/// | 39–42  | La1 (signed microdegrees) |\n/// | 43–46  | Lo1 (unsigned microdegrees, 0–360) |\n/// | 47     | resolution/component flags |\n/// | 48–51  | LaD (signed microdegrees, latitude where Dx/Dy are specified) |\n/// | 52–55  | LoV (unsigned microdegrees, orientation / central meridian) |\n/// | 56–59  | Dx (units per Table 3.3 bit 5) |\n/// | 60–63  | Dy (units per Table 3.3 bit 5) |\n/// | 64     | projection centre flag (Table 3.5; bit 7=0 North Pole, bit 7=1 South Pole) |\n/// | 65     | scanning mode |\nfn parse_gdt_20(b: &mut Buf, num_data_points: u32) -> Result<GridDefinition> {\n    let shape_of_earth = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 15\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 16–20: earth radius scale + value\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 21–25: major axis\n    b.skip(1 + 4)?;                       // oct 26–30: minor axis\n\n    let nx = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 31–34: Nx\n    let ny = b.read_u32be()?;             // oct 35–38: Ny\n\n b.read_u8()?;  // oct 47\n\n    let lad = b.read_latlon_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;       // oct 48–51: LaD\n    let lov = b.read_longi_micro()? as f64 / 1_000_000.0;        // oct 52–55: LoV\n\n    // Dx and Dy units depend on bit 5 of resolution_flags (Table 3.3):\n    // 0 = metres, 1 = millimetres\n    let dx_raw = b.read_u32be()? as f64;   // oct 56–59: Dx (units per resolution flags)\n    let dy_raw = b.read_u32be()? as f64;   // oct 60–63: Dy (units per resolution flags)\n    let dx_m = if resolution_flags & 0x20 != 0 { dx_raw / 1000.0 } else { dx_raw };\n    let dy_m = if resolution_flags & 0x20 != 0 { dy_raw / 1000.0 } else { dy_raw };\n\n    let proj_centre = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 64\n    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 65\n\n    let projection = GridProjection::PolarStereographic(PolarStereographicParams {\n        lad, lov, dx_m, dy_m, proj_centre,\n    });\n\n    Ok(GridDefinition {\n        template: 20,\n        num_data_points,\n        nx,\n        ny,\n        lat_first,\n        lon_first,\n        lat_last: 0.0,  // not stored in GDT 3.20; derive via projection if needed\n        lon_last: 0.0,\n        di: 0.0,        // increment in metres, stored in PolarStereographicParams\n        dj: 0.0,\n        scanning_mode,\n        resolution_flags,\n        shape_of_earth,\n        projection,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Grid 15     | shape of earth |\n/// | 16–20  | earth radius scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 21–25  | major-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 26–30  | minor-axis scale + value (skipped) |\n/// | 31–34 microdegrees) |\n/// | 52–55  | LoV (unsigned microdegrees) |\n/// | 56–59  | Dx (units per Table 3.3 bit 5) |\n/// | 60–63  | Dy (units per Table 3.3 bit 5) |\n/// | 64     | projection centre flag |\n/// | 65     | scanning mode |\n/// | 66–69  | Latin1 (signed microdegrees) |\n/// | 70–73  | Latin2 (signed microdegrees) |\n/// | 74–77  | lat south pole (signed microdegrees) |\n/// | 78–81  |
